notes.title: Thrive In Chaos Giveaway!
notes.content:
We’re back with another giveaway opportunity with a stylish limited edition t-shirt up for grabs designed by in-house artist, Ronja. This time, we want to test your virtual photography potential.

Are you the kind of player who thrives in total chaos? We want to see it! Show us your wildest, most intense, over-the-top moments from the game. Whether it’s an explosion-filled battlefield or the most ridiculous in-game fight you’ve survived — we want it all! 

To Enter: Snap a screenshot of your most chaotic in-game scene. Share it on your favourite social media platform or (don’t forget to tag us!). That’s it — Nitro will personally review all entries and pick the most epic one.

As before, the winner will receive a voucher to claim their limited-edition t-shirt with free shipping and the option to customise their order through the new Nitro Games Store. This ensures that you get the shirt in a size that you want, and not something that we’ve pre-ordered for you.

Giveaway ends: June 16th 2025
Terms & Conditions: https://www.nitrogames.com/contest-tcs/

notes.title: Dodge. Roll. Dominate! Welcome to Autogun Heroes: Supercharged
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/2eb04c713209fa471dff03f632689d97bdedb2bf.png

The galaxy is under siege by alien invaders, and it’s up to you to take it back! Dive into Autogun Heroes: Supercharged, a thrilling 2D shoot-'em-up that blends skill-based platforming with tight, responsive controls. Assemble a team of unique heroes, optimize their abilities, and dominate your way through action-packed worlds. Dodge. Roll. Dominate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/9b27e65059759b7251536e48127ee7104771a383.png

What to Expect:

 Skill-Based Action: Experience fast-paced 2D platforming combined with responsive controls for precise and satisfying gameplay.
 Diverse Hero Roster: Assemble your team from a wide variety of heroes, each with unique abilities. Find the hero that matches your playstyle and strategy.
 Customizable Loadouts: Optimize your hero’s performance by equipping them with weapons, gadgets, and armor. Fine-tune their stats like damage, fire rate, and defense to match your playstyle.
 Alien Infested Planets to Re-Conquer: Fight across vast game worlds, each crawling with enemies and challenges. It’s your job to reclaim the galaxy!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342366/86b4320a08790aecc9fef8ba3898a5ca50297f00.png

Whether you’re blasting through alien hordes, perfecting your stats, or mastering skillful platforming, Autogun Heroes: Supercharged delivers an electrifying experience that will keep you on your toes.
The galaxy won’t save itself—are you ready to take the fight to the aliens?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3328730/Autogun_Heroes_Supercharged/
